module TopModule(input clock, input a, output reg p, output reg q);
    reg [1:0] state;
    always @(posedge clock) begin
        case (state)
            2'b00: begin p <= 0; q <= 0; if (a) state <= 2'b01; end
            2'b01: begin p <= 0; q <= 0; if (a) state <= 2'b10; else state <= 2'b00; end
            2'b10: begin p <= 1; q <= 0; if (a) state <= 2'b11; else state <= 2'b00; end
            2'b11: begin p <= 1; q <= 1; if (a) state <= 2'b11; else state <= 2'b00; end
        endcase
    end
endmodule
